newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SOCCER-LITHUANIAN STAR STRIKER HELPS SINK LIECHTENSTEIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LITHUANIAN STAR STRIKER HELPS SINK LIECHTENSTEIN.

text.p: Arminas Narbekovas, who plays for Austrian first division Admira Wacker, helped Lithuania to a 2-1 victory over part-timers Liechtenstein in a World Cup qualifier on Wednesday, scoring the winner with a stunning free-kick.

Narbekovas, who returned to the national side in the 2-0 win over Iceland last week after an 18-month absence due to injury, blasted a shot over the Liechtenstein wall in the 55th minute to seal victory in the European group eight tie.

Lithuania dominated the first half but failed to get past a solid Liechtenstein defence and goalkeeper Martin Heeb until the 43rd minute when Edgaras Jankauskas received the ball a few metres in front of the goal and slotted it in.

In a good spell at the start of the second half, Liechtenstein's Harry Zech found himself alone in the penalty box and managed to lift the ball over diving Lithuanian goalkeeper Gintaras Stauche to equalise in the 53rd minute.

Liechtenstein: 1-Martin Heeb, 2-Jurgen Ospelt, 3-Daniel Telser, 4-Roland Hiltl, 5-Thomas Hanselmann, 6-Philipp Beck, 7-Franz Schadler (15-Alexander Schadler, 75th), 8-Harry Zech, 9-Mario Frick, 10-Daniel Hasler, 11-Stefan Hassler (14-Patrik Marxer, 63rd).
